QUOTE: "Call 1 passes `nullptr` and a size of 0. llama.cpp answers with the negative of the required token count. This is a size probe, not an attempt that failed." and "No backoff, no repeated attempt at the same operation, no retry of a failure."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer concludes the double call is size negotiation (probe then sized call), not retry, and notes the absence of backoff.
